summary: Power Solutions International, Inc. (Nasdaq: PSIX) filed an 8-K on September 25, 2026, reporting entry into a new $220 million committed revolving credit agreement with HSBC as administrative agent and lenders including ANZ, Bank of China, and BNP Paribas. The facility matures September 25, 2029, bears interest at SOFR plus 1.80% or an alternate base rate, carries a 0.20% commitment fee, and includes a $70 million letter-of-credit sublimit. Proceeds fund working capital and general corporate purposes. This is a routine credit-facility event, not a special situation.
